caption: Lek bridge, Culemborg
composition: Steel tied-arch railway bridge over the Lek, seen from the harbour · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the harbour head at Culemborg the Lek fills the foreground and the railway bridge crosses it: a steel tied arch on the piers of the older crossing, with approach spans over the floodplain. The sky is clear, about 12.9°C, with wind near 10.1 km/h. The 1868 truss is gone. The Binnenpoort stands in the walled centre and is not in this frame.
